verdict.rationale: Calendly's own docs say users can connect multiple calendars and that synced calendars are checked for conflicts before someone books. Community users independently call checking multiple calendars to find open blocks Calendly's 'killer feature'. missing for 10: explicit documentation of which providers are supported (Outlook and Apple/iCloud are not named; only Google/Microsoft sign-up appears), and detail on how conflicts are checked across every connected calendar.

support.subject: As a knowledge worker, I can connect several calendars (Google, Outlook, Apple) and every one is checked for conflicts so I never get double-booked

citations.quote: Only get booked when you want to be. Connect multiple calendars and fine-tune your availability with meeting buffers, custom schedules, and daily limits.
Sync your calendars so Calendly can check for conflicts before someone books time.
Calendly still has the killer feature of being able to check multiple calendars to find scheduling blocks.
